description: The prompt window (Ask Fritz, declared hidden in tauri.conf.json): the events it listens to, nothing else. Its app commands (prompt_say, prompt_close, get_settings, companion_status, avatar_status) are not ACL-checked without an app manifest, and must be granted here if one is ever added; prompt_say and prompt_close check the calling window themselves. It is never given companion_config, a global shortcut, or a window's focus call: the shell takes and hands back the keyboard.
